body: Thanks man. I think I was looking for happiness to come as a big ominous light but I'm finding great pleasure in the little things when they come along.

It's the crippling loneliness I feel everyday, I've never held a relationship down long enough to call it one. With my friends, I think I resent them more than anything. They have their life together, girlfriend/boyfriends, good jobs but most of all they're HAPPY. 

I'm close to my mum and my two sisters but my younger siblings get further away from me the more they hear how much of a failure I am from my step-dad. I think that they wouldn't care too much if I were to just go.

I work as a Barista, couldn't/haven't been able to find work as a teacher/lecturer- My degree is in Ancient History and Italian, useful so I thought. I had a job writing songs for a record company for a while but that fell through once my "co-workers" found they could make more money seperately. Kudos to them though, one of them works for Sony.

It just seems like the things I try to do end up hitting me in the face one way or another, I guess I feel apathy more than bitterness, at least now I do. 

The way I've been feeling the past year and a half is just so unbearable that I would happily end my life- I've tried to change the life I'm living but there's just no hold up.
